label: General
guidance: Write concise, useful social copy that can be adapted for different channels.

label: UFIConnect
guidance: Write a clear community update with useful context and an optional discussion question.

label: Bluesky
guidance: Keep each draft within 300 characters. Use conversational text and few hashtags.

label: Mastodon
guidance: Keep each draft within 500 characters. Use descriptive language and a few relevant hashtags.

label: X / Twitter
guidance: Keep each draft within 280 characters, including any hashtags.

label: Threads
guidance: Keep each draft within 500 characters. Use a natural conversational hook.

label: Facebook
guidance: Write an approachable page or community update with enough context to stand alone.

label: Reddit
guidance: Write a useful, specific discussion post. Avoid marketing slogans and hashtags; do not invent subreddit rules.

label: Discord
guidance: Write a concise server announcement with a clear heading and short bullets. Do not invent roles, channel names, or mass mentions.

label: Instagram
guidance: Write a visual caption with a short opening hook and a few relevant hashtags. Do not claim an image contains details not supplied.

label: TikTok
guidance: Write a brief video caption with a clear hook and a few relevant hashtags, without claiming a video was created or posted.

label: YouTube
guidance: Write a video description with an opening summary and useful context. Do not invent timestamps, links, or sponsorships.

label: Twitch
guidance: Write a stream announcement or description. Do not invent a live status, schedule, game, or channel URL.

label: LinkedIn
guidance: Write a professional update with concrete context and a useful takeaway. Avoid invented achievements or credentials.

label: GitHub
guidance: Write a project announcement or release note in simple Markdown. Use bullets; do not invent features, versions, benchmarks, or repository links.

label: GitLab
guidance: Write a project update or release note with short Markdown bullets. Do not invent implemented work or issue links.

label: Figma
guidance: Write a design handoff or community resource description. Explain the supplied design context without inventing files, components, or licenses.

label: Pinterest
guidance: Write a concise Pin description with a clear topic and natural search terms. Do not invent a destination URL.

label: Tumblr
guidance: Write an expressive short blog post with relevant tags only where useful.

label: Medium
guidance: Write an article introduction or short article outline, with a clear main idea and useful supporting points.

label: WordPress.com
guidance: Write a blog introduction or concise draft with headings and supporting points.

label: DEV Community
guidance: Write a developer article introduction or project explanation in Markdown. Do not invent code behavior or test results.

label: Hashnode
guidance: Write a technical blog introduction with a clear problem and useful outline. Do not invent experience, measurements, or code behavior.
